baseline.provenance: The 83-group baseline qualified by prism continuation and the subsequent upstream format integration. Those merges changed no BREP/dependency runtime sources. Copied before this increment replaces the shared target artifact.

candidate.scope: All seventy-one preserved groups plus twelve circular-prism, STEP and exact-scalar continuation groups. Workspace path dependencies, not a shipped JS or package consumer.

scope: Full original workloads, iteration counts, exact assertions, fresh/reused document states and output materialization. Three alternating pairs per corpus on a shared host. Allocator requests are cumulative, RSS is per complete process, and neither is a retained-heap bound. Harness sizes are not package sizes. Median across case ratios is descriptive, not an aggregate workload speedup. No timing row alone decides retention.
